title: Acquirer: Smith & Nephew plc; Target: Centerpulse AG

body_sections.Summary: Proposed acquisition of Centerpulse AG by Smith & Nephew plc
body_sections.Market definition: The relevant market was considered to be the separate national markets for the supply of hip and knee orthopaedic implants
body_sections.Competition analysis: While the proposed acquisition would exceed the Commission's concentration thresholds for each market, the following factors indicate that the proposed acquisition is unlikely to substantially lessen competition: * Centrepulse does not appear to be a significant competitor in Australia; * imports of the relevant products account for virtually all domestic sales; * barriers to entry for the manufacture and the importing and supply of the relevant products appear to be generally low; * there will remain a number of alternative suppliers to whom customers could turn; and *public hospitals appear to possess some degree of countervailing power through competitive tendering for the relevant products.
